subject: Separate a certain chromosome from Affy GenomeWide SNP 6.0 chip

messages.author: 42289145a8c4bc6e
messages.subject: Separate a certain chromosome from Affy GenomeWide SNP 6.0 chip
parts:
Hi all,

Now I have about 1500 CEL files which are Affymetricx GenomeWideSNP
6.0 chip. I would like to separate only chromosome 6 from this data
set by using aroma-affymetrix, and to get the intensity data and
genotype data. Please let me know how to separate only chromosome 6
from the data effectively, and to get the intensity data and genotype
data.

Thank you for your help.

Yasu

> genotype data. Please let me know how to separate only chromosome 6

could you please specify more precisely what you mean by "intensity
data"? Do you mean the probe intensities or the summarized signals?
They are quite different and most people are only interested in the
summarized signals.

It is easy to identify the units (loci) that are on Chr6 using the
GenomeInformationFile class. The online Vignette 'Calculating Raw
Total Copy Numbers Manually' illustrates how to do this. If you need
probe signals you then have to identify the cell (probe) indices part
of these units in order to read the probe signals from Chr6. If you
work with summarized data, you don't need this, and extractDataFrame()
can be used. If you specify what you want to do more precisely, then
we can point you in the right direction.

There is currently no genotyping calling algorithm implemented in
aroma.affymetrix, so you cannot get genotype calls. It is on the todo
list to implement support for the CRLMM genotyping algorithm, but that
will take some time.

If you not familiar with aroma.affymetrix, I recommend that you start
reading the online 'User Guide' and the 'Vignettes'. Take a small
subset of your arrays and try to follow the Vignette 'Total Copy
Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0)' - I think that will clarify how
aroma.affymetrix works.

Cheers
